verdict.rationale: Skyvern has no documented native rules engine for event-based triggers. The closest evidence is a first-party Zapier connection, which lets external events start Skyvern runs, plus scheduling of agents built in Copilot/Studio. A run-completion webhook_url POST can also chain downstream actions. Each of these is a thin mention, and the trigger logic would live in Zapier rather than in Skyvern. Missing for 10: a native event-trigger/rule definition capability, documentation of which events can trigger agents, detail on how the Zapier integration works, and any hands-on corroboration.
